title: A2 replication threshold and negative-control ablations

A1.space_label: physical_r_free_0 = exact reduced-state map/pose tangent with no free-current block; envelope_Cw = declared left singular directions of the realified data tangent

summary.note: Zero envelope visibility is an envelope diagnostic only; it is never labelled physical nonidentifiability (G0-D).
Relative-only and residual-only gates pass by construction on b_zero and small-residual-large-bias when their thresholds are loose; absolute/bias-aware gates are the intended controls.

compensation_criterion.criterion_note: Stacked pose visible iff [T2-T1; T3-T1] is full column rank when each a_l is injective and each frame hides every pose direction.

summary.note: The shared-map stack (not the per-frame sum) is the exact criterion; independent-map visibility is the mismatch control.
Raw policy logdets are recorded for every (lambda, noise) combination; certification tolerances only label the gap, they do not change the algorithm or the objective.
